# Ancient Iranian Studies

Ancient Iranian Studies is a scholarly journal publishing papers on ancient Iran.
Background
The journal was established by Shahin Aryamanesh in 2022. The articles are in English and Persian. According to the official website of Ancient Iranian Studies, the journal covers studies on the culture and civilization of pre-Islamic Persia in its broadest sense. Ancient Iranian Studies publishes on Persian Studies, including archaeology, ancient history, linguistics, religion, epigraphy, numismatics, and the history of art of ancient Iran, as well as on cultural exchanges and relations between Persia and its neighbours. This journal is published by Tissaphernes Archaeological Research Group.
Ancient Iranian Studies is an open access journal and indexed in Scopus on 28 Dec 2023.
